The objectives of this notebook will be to conduct exploratory data analyses on site inherent characteristics of the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet Clean version using the baseline conditions (HA 10% Closed System). This file should be run after the EDA.Rmd

# Preparing the Variables

Set the working directory

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt_sep/Zinc/4. Exploratory data analysis")
```

Upload the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet dataset

```{r}
library(readxl)

dat <- read_excel("Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean2.xlsx", 
    sheet = "HA 10% Closed System")

# Preview
head(dat)
```

# Site Characteristics

Nested

```{r}
# Nested
library(dplyr)

sites_by_characteristics <- dat %>%
  # Keep only the columns we care about
  select(
    Site,
    Type,
    Regime,
    Development
  ) %>%
  
  # Ensure each site is only counted once per category combo
  distinct() %>%
  
  # Group by inherent characteristics
  group_by(
    Type,
    Regime,
    Development
  ) %>%
  
  # Count sites
  summarise(
    n_Sites = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sites_by_characteristics

# Save
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Inherent_characteristics_summary.xlsx"

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Sites within characteristics")
writeData(wb, "Sites within characteristics", sites_by_characteristics)


```

Separate

```{r}
library(dplyr) 
# Type
sites_by_type <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, Type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Sites = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sites_by_type

# Regime
sites_by_regime <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, Regime) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Regime) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Sites = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sites_by_regime

# Development
sites_by_development <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, Development) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Development) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Sites = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sites_by_development

# Save
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Inherent_characteristics_summary.xlsx"

wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)

update_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  if (sheet_name %in% names(wb)) {
    removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  }
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, data)
}

update_sheet(wb, "Sites by type", sites_by_type)
update_sheet(wb, "Sites by regime", sites_by_regime)
update_sheet(wb, "Sites by development", sites_by_development)

saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
```

Sites retained

```{r}
library(dplyr)

sites <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, Network) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Network)

sites

# Save
update_sheet(wb, "Sites retained", sites)

saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
```
